description: Leb Nyankole giloko kwede ki dano milion adek i Ankole, i godi me Uganda tung piny, cok ki Mbarara, lobo pa dyang ma tunggi bor.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Acholi courses (#130) with low confidence in Acholi; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: Leb me **Ankole ki dyang ma tunggi bor.**
why.text: Leb Nyankole giloko kwede i Mbarara, Bushenyi, Ntungamo ki Ibanda, dok cok ki Leb Kiga ki Leb Nyoro. Pwonye pi dog gang, wot, tic, ki wer ki ododo me Ankole.

cards.title: Pi dog gang
cards.text: Lok ki kwaro ki wat i Ankole.

cards.title: Pi luwot
cards.text: Wot cakke ki Mbarara cito wa Kabale ki nam Bunyonyi.

cards.title: Pi jo ma mito ngeyo
cards.text: Nong kit nying, nyukuta mabor ki lok me dyang.

sample.prompt: Lok mene ma tyen lok ne “apwoyo”?

landing.audience: Jo ma loko Leb Acoli ma gicako manyen, dog gang ma oa ki Ankole, ki luwot ma gicito tung piny me Uganda.
landing.first: Moto, tito nyingi ki kwan wel, lacen dog gang, cam, cuk, cawa, kabedo, gang ki yot kom, dul ki dul.

cast.emma: Welo ma tye ka pwonye Leb Nyankole ma peya owoto
